description: Calculate the PBE+U band gap of bulk CdS (wurtzite). PBE severely underestimates the gap.
user_prompt: Calculate the band gap of bulk CdS (wurtzite structure, P6_3mc) and report its value in eV.

method.modeling: Use bulk wurtzite CdS in the P6_3mc structure and report the direct Gamma-point band gap.
method.rationale: The scored value is the GGA+U direct Gamma-point gap reported for wurtzite CdS with Ud(Cd 4d)=4.5 eV and Up(S 3p)=4.2 eV. The same work reports a plain PBE-GGA gap of 1.10 eV, illustrating the severe PBE underestimate relative to the experimental gap near 2.42 eV. The absolute tolerance covers VASP-versus-QE implementation differences, relaxed-geometry sensitivity, and k-point convergence.
